shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package-lock.json | head -30 && node -v && npm -v

cat package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "--- $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | grep -i router

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.js ThemeProvider.d.ts; ls ../../../../../icons | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/icons 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(Sun|Moon|House|Gear|Circle(Info|Question))\.js$"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n "icons" package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
